provenance.method: Loaded and answered Embed at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Embed requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Embed requests on three short sentences.

Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Embed request on three short sentences.
